name: Château-Grillet

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

land: Faces toward the sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A tiny northern Rhône appellation in the Rhône Valley, owned by a single winery. It makes white wine from Viognier and is effectively an enclave within Condrieu, which also makes Viognier-only whites.
